body.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), uniform equal allocation gives \(Z_n(W_{n,0})\Rightarrow\mathcal N_{k+1}(0,I_{k+1})\), and the score construction satisfies \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n)=b_n^{\mathsf T}D_n(W_{n,\mathrm{stop}})+s_nE_n(W_{n,\mathrm{stop}})\) exactly.
body.justification: This identifies the complete-randomization initialization and the exact causal decomposition that the stopped process must transport.
body.gap: Li and Ding give the finite-population vector CLT at a fixed complete-randomization draw, not along the Zhu--Liu first-entry path.
body.consumer: The joint normalization supplies the initial law for the stopped martingale problem and the ATE scaling used by every later interval result.
